observations.assessment: Current Request identity, principal/policy/access revision, case incarnation/membership and transaction target are revalidated. C08 CAS, namespace isolation, idempotency receipts and protected callback writer guards remain present. SQLite commit is awaited; nested writes poison/reject rather than silently commit.

Actual SDK transport/listTools/callTool uses private single-use leases and current generation; profile/skill grants are intersected. Homonymous providers reject. Both transports close before final revalidation/output capture. Resident sources have physical-path/digest checks. SessionV2 and stream token enforcement are integrated; no installed-native AM receipt inferred from static code.

Memoized completed proofs are bounded to a single current Request/call/binding/case/source/UTC-day scope. Reentrant and mixed/history inputs leave the narrow fast path. Protected Atlas reads revalidate partition/case/current source authority at egress; capture bytes do not grant a fresh write. Real Atlas factories and scanner boundary are used.

New helper accepts only planner:scenario, planner-runtime-v1 and a record-only source closure. It requires an existing protected original capture, an exact ledger association, the same physical case with a later current version, a persisted request/result, canonical producer replay and repeated Request/C08/source/day/capture fences. It returns original projection plus case.version difference; it cannot register requests, persist results or grant current issuance. No concrete authority bypass found in examined paths.

The explicit factory joins the existing listener and host contribution graph. Routes enforce configured origin/host; assets use checked-in literal entries and failures remain unavailable. Host lease/session cleanup and installation finalizers are wired. README identifies C07/C12/native/historical limits and does not claim global release. Installed distribution/bundle/browser behavior still requires the designated evidence.

Check envelope validates declared W as HEAD first parent and permits only added .astra-compose-check.json relative to W, then checks out W and records W/tree/dev before package checks. Delivery mode permits only new 100644 WP00/WP10 json/md/txt receipts and runs real guards on D. This subset check is not full C/G7 or D/G8 qualification: receipt content/provenance and absence of new import/glob/build/runtime inputs require separate verification.

wp11_bounded_intake.assessment: Static closure is compatible with W8 imports/contracts/C08/prepared-apply. Durable attempt uses existing state.transactions, advances namespace but not case.version, and the domain reopens storage after reservation. Reconciliation reads cases again after receipt commit. W8 lacks rejectChange, so the new mutations rejectChange feature is not a dependency of this closure. No local execution or acceptance of the failed source run.
wp11_bounded_intake.behavior_change: A committed reservation without an authoritative receipt remains indeterminate and cannot dispatch again, including a crash before actual domain dispatch.
wp11_bounded_intake.separate_open_dependency: mutations.ts no-op coverage does not capture the protected source proof when reassessment is skipped; this source publication does not close promotion coverage.
